nodes.label: Ghost Replica AI
nodes.rationale: The client replica has no randomness or update loop and is driven only by server ghost state broadcasts; it is visual-only and must not perform judgments.

nodes.label: Shared Configuration Single Source
nodes.rationale: One shared configuration prevents frontend and backend values from drifting apart.

nodes.label: Global 100ms Server Tick
nodes.rationale: A single global setInterval advances every room instead of allocating a timer per room.

nodes.label: In-Memory Room State
nodes.rationale: Room state currently exists only in memory, so a server restart loses games and historical rankings.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Judgment
nodes.rationale: All movement, ghost visibility, capture, acceleration, and victory judgments are performed on the server so clients cannot cheat.
